# Video Production Studio

A Muse agent skill that coordinates brief-to-video production: route the request (slideshows, captions, overlays, motion graphics, music videos, explainers), render with ffmpeg, then inspect every delivery — technical checks plus actual frame-by-frame visual QC. Paid or metered steps (AI generation, hosted narration) need your approval first; without it, it builds from supplied and bundled assets. Ported from a community plugin.
